scope: Steel and Cedar Medieval campaign terrain; other themes and creator previews retain their authored scenes.
changes: Connected subdivided ground with shared edges, world-space rolling heights and feathered natural material boundaries.
Level river water, shaped banks and flat pads with a buffer around authored landmarks.
Unit footing, live movement and selection overlays follow the shaped terrain.
Branched trees and textured foliage, weathered rocks, rooted grass and crops, bamboo stem joints and narrow leaves.
Shared foliage, stem and grass geometry rendered with MultiMesh instancing.
Recursive scenery occlusion includes instanced trees and preserves shared source materials.
Vegetation and water animation follow the same board clock, including controlled captures and disabled motion.
limits: Local software-rendered captures are not hardware FPS measurements.
New-scene Android and desktop hardware performance is pending a later profiling pass.
Other built-in themes and creator previews still need this landscape treatment.
